items.title: Check every citation against its source before it goes in the catalog
items.summary: Confirm the title and date from the paper's arXiv abstract page (the citation_title and citation_date meta tags) or the ACL Anthology page. The arXiv API rate-limits bursts (HTTP 429), so fall back to the abstract pages when checking many at once. Never publish a citation an agent wrote from memory.

items.title: Edit data, not pages
items.summary: Every list on the hub renders from JSON: research/catalog.json for papers (use the topics field to place an entry on Methods pages) and research/lab/entries.json for tips. Adding an entry never requires touching HTML.

items.title: Log every trial, not just the averaged score
items.summary: Store successes and attempts per task (and per trial if you can). Averages cannot be turned back into pass@k, pass^k, clustered standard errors, or paired comparisons; raw trial counts can. EvalBench takes exactly this format.
